|game_text=Deploys only on Endor. Once per game, may take an Endor site into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Game text of your other scouts here may not be canceled. During any deploy phase, if an Imperial at an adjacent site, Wuta may move to that site (using landspeed) as a regular move.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Wuta (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Wuta (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Once per game, may take an Endor site into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Game text of your other scouts here may not be canceled. During any deploy phase, if an Imperial at an adjacent site, Wuta may move to that site (using landspeed) as a regular move.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Wuta (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Wuta”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Wuta (V)]] (published 9 April 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Wuta]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
